_readme: One object per Sword Trial / Hero's Realm. See README.md for field meanings. Keep wording in your own words; link every source.

encounters.name: Compass & Chime

requirements.party: Recommended 3 DPS, 1 healer, 1 tank. Minimum 2 DPS + 1 healer; a tank is optional (whereguildsmeet.org).
bring: Burst damage for the shield windows (iron shell, Bell Toller's shield)
notes: Pick chain players and bell handlers before you queue: the fight is all assignments.
Guides name PC keys; on console, check which button is your interact and your deflect.
Claims cost 60 Energy/Stamina each, so you can repeat it as long as you have Energy.

duties.lodestar: Aim Lodestar's charge along the yellow line so a chain can cross it.
duties.bell-toller: Hold Bell Toller in place so bells can be turned to face him.

duties.lodestar: Chain across charge paths and the flying sword's path. For Charge Strike, use the two pillars in front of him and chain them to his body.
duties.bell-toller: Bell handlers: knock bells over before Resonant Toll; turn openings toward the boss for Endless Echo and Drumbeat.

duties.lodestar: Pre-heal two scripted damage windows: the iron-shell phase before he goes airborne, and every World Ablaze dash.
duties.bell-toller: Top the group up before Resonant Toll and after Drumbeat.

duties.lodestar: Break the iron shell fast, then burst while he's pulled down.
duties.bell-toller: Free anyone trapped under a bell first. Hold burst while he has 70% damage reduction.

bosses.name: Lodestar (Swordmaster)
bosses.summary: A chain fight. Four chain pillars sit in the corners, and a chain can only link two pillars next to each other (four legal chains; none cross the middle). Chain pillar to pillar to block charges and the flying sword. Chain pillar to boss to interrupt Charge Strike or pull him down. A correct block stuns him.

mechanics.name: Charge
mechanics.trigger: A yellow line shows the direction he will charge.
mechanics.response: Two players stretch a chain across that line. He stuns himself on it and takes extra damage.

mechanics.name: Flaming Flying Sword
mechanics.trigger: He targets a player and a sword appears on them.
mechanics.response: Target runs to the arena edge. When Intercept starts, link two chains across the sword's flight path before the countdown ends. One chain is not enough.

mechanics.name: World Ablaze
mechanics.trigger: He shields up and dashes around the edge; every edge hit deals AoE damage and stacks a damage buff on him.
mechanics.response: Block the dashes with chains like Charge. Each block strips some shield. Then burn the rest of the shield before more stacks build.

mechanics.name: Flaming Swordcut
mechanics.trigger: Golden circles appear under targeted players.
mechanics.response: Drop your circle in open space, away from pillars. A circle on a pillar burns it out for 25 seconds.

mechanics.name: Charge Strike
mechanics.trigger: He goes invincible and a countdown to a raid-wide hit starts.
mechanics.response: Two players use the front pillars and attach both chains to his body (not to each other) to interrupt it.

mechanics.name: Airborne: Iron Shell (Wings Aflame)
mechanics.trigger: He flies up and seals one pillar in an iron shell, attacking nonstop.
mechanics.response: Break the shell, chain from the freed pillar, and get all four chains onto him to drag him down for a damage window.

talents.condition: Block his charge twice.
Block every charge for the whole fight.
Intercept him at least 4 times during World Ablaze and break the flame shield within 70 seconds.
talents.notes: The game counts the intercepts during World Ablaze, not ordinary charges.

talents.condition: Interrupt Charge Strike with the chains once.
talents.notes: The video says 'break the gold shield'; the in-game text says interrupt Charged Strike using the front chains.

talents.condition: Never let a Flaming Flying Sword self-destruct, all fight.
Pull him down within 20 seconds during Wings Aflame.

bosses.name: Bell Toller
bosses.summary: A bell fight. Bells trap players, fire soundwaves and must be knocked over or turned toward him at the right moment.

mechanics.name: Call of the Bell
mechanics.trigger: A random player is trapped under a big bronze bell.
mechanics.response: Everyone hits the bell to free them, then knock that bell over for the next mechanic.

mechanics.name: Resonant Toll
mechanics.trigger: Yellow rectangles appear from fallen bells.
mechanics.response: Have every bell down before this: standing bells fire arena-wide, fallen bells only fire straight ahead. Step out of the lanes. Anyone still trapped dies instantly, so free them first.

mechanics.name: Endless Echo (Bronze Horse)
mechanics.trigger: A bronze horse chases a random player while he charges an arena-wide attack.
mechanics.response: Turn one bell's opening toward him. The chased player leads the horse into that bell; the soundwave must reach the boss to interrupt.

mechanics.name: Terrestrial Drumbeat (shield)
mechanics.trigger: Big shield, repeated ground slams, countdown on his HP bar.
mechanics.response: Turn several bells to face him and fire soundwaves to break the shield before the timer (wipe if it runs out). Afterwards he enrages with 70% damage reduction: hold burst until it ends.
mechanics.note: The in-game callout for the enrage is "I'm getting angry!".

mechanics.name: Fly Swatter / Big Butt Slam
mechanics.trigger: Red-flash melee attacks.
mechanics.response: Deflect them (in-game callouts).

mechanics.name: Take My Hammer → No One Runs!
mechanics.trigger: Numbers over everyone's head rank players by damage dealt.
mechanics.response: He throws his hammer at players in that order. Use each throw to smash standing bells; higher numbers stand farther out. Don't drag throws away from bells. If more than one bell is left when No One Runs! hits, the party wipes.
mechanics.note: Guild notes add: stand bells up and stand next to them so each throw smashes one.

talents.condition: Kick over a bell to rescue a trapped teammate once.
Take no Resonance damage while a bell is down.
During Take My Hammer!, destroy every bell, and nobody trapped under a bell dies to Resonance.
During Endless Echo or Terrestrial Drumbeat, keep a bell turned toward him and hit him with it once.
Take no damage from the copper horse's charge during Endless Echo.
Break his shield before his second jump in Terrestrial Drumbeat, with no deaths in that phase.

commonFailures.text: Only one chain across the flying sword: it recovers and keeps attacking (breaks 2-2).
A Swordcut circle dropped on a pillar burns it for 25 seconds, so you're a chain short.
Chaining the two pillars to each other instead of to his body during Charge Strike.
Bells left standing when Resonant Toll fires, or a teammate still trapped.
Baiting the hammer away from bells, so two or more survive into No One Runs!
Kicking the bell over is how you rescue a trapped teammate for 1-1; breaking it the slow way doesn't count.

rewards: Inner Way Note: Custom Chest x3 (+3 first clear)
Chance: Melodic Stone / Attunement Stone: Dustless, Homebound Bow recipes, Brainy Bell and Shattered Crest appearances
Chime Chest / Compass Chest via Chivalry Voucher exchange (60 Stamina per claim)
Tier 100 Material x6 (name to be confirmed)

encounters.name: Dragonscale Tamer

bring: Tai Chi on every player (Feng Ruzhi: reflect water swords, throw bombs back)
notes: Pre-assign five spread spots for Ground Slam, and one flagpole per player for Feng Ruzhi.
Talent 1-1 is easier if you enter as tank (Where Guilds Meet).

duties.horse-tamer: Hold your spread spot like everyone else.
duties.feng-ruzhi: Grab the Silk Embroidered Ball at the start and don't lose it. Call red or gold circles on you.

duties.horse-tamer: Line the boss up behind you before deflecting Ground Slam.
duties.feng-ruzhi: Jump into the ball holder's red circle and deflect together.

duties.horse-tamer: Own one of five spread spots. In Chase Phase, stand on arrow markers to close routes and pick up herbs.
duties.feng-ruzhi: Own one flagpole: reflect the water sword from its gold circle with Tai Chi, and jump up it for Dragondive.

bosses.name: Horse Tamer
bosses.summary: Deflect-and-redirect fight. Aim his own slams back at him, and herd him back to the middle when he runs.

mechanics.name: Ground Slam
mechanics.trigger: A red line locks onto a player; sometimes one strike, sometimes a fast chain across several players.
mechanics.response: Stand so the line runs from you through the boss, and deflect as it lands. The redirected slam hits him and interrupts Poison Wave. Stay spread so nobody eats someone else's slam.

mechanics.name: Poison Wave
mechanics.trigger: Poison warning on screen; a big channel that can wipe a low-HP group.
mechanics.response: Interrupt it by landing a redirected Ground Slam on him.

mechanics.name: Consecutive Jumps
mechanics.trigger: The horse leaps and slams the ground again and again.
mechanics.response: Deflect every slam (spam it) until the prompt says he's back in the middle field.

mechanics.name: Chase Phase
mechanics.trigger: He jumps to the edge and tries to break out through the wooden maze, sending shockwaves.
mechanics.response: He is immune outside the centre, so ignore damage. Deflect the shockwaves to drain his Qi, stand on arrow markers to block routes, and herd him back to the centre.

mechanics.name: Thrashing
mechanics.trigger: Periodic arena-wide hits while he's outside the centre; can't be avoided.
mechanics.response: Finish herding fast to limit how many land.

mechanics.name: Herbs
mechanics.trigger: Herbs spawn at the edge during Chase Phase.
mechanics.response: Pick them up: each heals the party, and talents need them.

mechanics.name: Reckless Charge
mechanics.trigger: A red rectangle aimed down a blocked path.
mechanics.response: If you're in it, deflect as it lands to hold the block.
mechanics.note: The in-game name. Game8 calls it Relentless Charge; Where Guilds Meet calls it Brutal Charge.

talents.condition: Redirect a Ground Slam into him to interrupt Poison Wave at least once.
Deflect every slam in one Consecutive Jumps sequence.
talents.notes: Spam deflect; one miss voids it.

talents.condition: Poison Wave never goes off, and no one is hit by a Ground Slam aimed at someone else.
Stop the horse once by deflecting Reckless Charge.
Trigger herb healing twice during the fight.
talents.notes: Game8 and Where Guilds Meet say 'two herbs in one Chase Phase'; the in-game text just says twice in the battle.

talents.condition: In every Chase Phase, collect every herb and get him back to the centre within 60 seconds.

bosses.name: Feng Ruzhi
bosses.summary: Silk-ball fight on a platform with five flagpoles. Losing the ball fills her Disappointment Meter; when it's full she goes Berserk (shield + permanent 20% damage).
bosses.worldBossNote: Feng Ruzhi is also a world boss. The world-boss guide (bring Tai Chi, companion Ruby) doesn't cover the trial's flagpole and ball mechanics.

mechanics.name: Silk Embroidered Ball
mechanics.trigger: Fight start.
mechanics.response: One player picks it up and keeps it. A dropped ball respawns along the flagpole ribbons: grab it again immediately.

mechanics.name: Master Loves the Match
mechanics.trigger: Red circle on the ball holder.
mechanics.response: At least two players get into the circle and deflect together (in-game callout; Game8 says three, which is safer), or the holder is knocked out and drops the ball.

mechanics.name: Gold circle on ball holder
mechanics.trigger: Gold circle on the holder.
mechanics.response: Everyone else stays out. Anyone inside is launched off the platform. If you're knocked off, spam jump and take the Cloud Steps prompt to a flagpole to get back (being outside drains HP).

mechanics.name: Dancing Dragons' Leader
mechanics.trigger: Minions on the flagpoles throw time bombs.
mechanics.response: Catch bombs with Tai Chi and throw them back to knock minions off. The ball can appear on a minion. Throw spare bombs out of the arena: clustered bombs hit hard.

mechanics.name: Berserk: Hall of Madness
mechanics.trigger: Gold circles on everyone, then a red circle on one player.
mechanics.response: Spread so gold circles don't overlap, then everyone stacks in the red circle and deflects together. This takes a big chunk of shield.

mechanics.name: Soaring Dragon Ascends
mechanics.trigger: Water swords wave toward each flagpole in turn.
mechanics.response: Stand in your pole's gold circle and use Tai Chi as it nearly fills to reflect the sword. Each reflect hurts her shield. A miss causes arena-wide damage (still deflectable).

mechanics.name: Dragondive
mechanics.trigger: Huge gold arena-wide attack charging.
mechanics.response: Jump onto your own flagpole as the circle appears (one per pole). Drop down after and be ready to deflect the red follow-ups.

mechanics.name: Berserk shield
mechanics.trigger: Shield active during Berserk.
mechanics.response: Break it fast with red-attack deflects and Tai Chi reflects. If it lasts too long she casts 'Contest Over' and wipes the party.

talents.condition: In Hall of Madness, break her shield within 90 seconds and reflect the water-sword wave with Tai Chi.
In Hall of Madness, break her shield within 70 seconds with more than 10 deflects.
No player dies from falling off the arena.
talents.notes: Game8: no one dies after being knocked off the platform.

talents.condition: Pick up the embroidered (silk) ball at least twice in one run.
Throw a Heaven-Shaker bomb with Tai Chi to knock the Bloodscale Hall members off a flagpole.
Everyone jumps onto the flagpoles during River-Sundering Charge and Submerged Dragon.
talents.notes: Game8 describes these as the Berserk arena-wide hits (Dragondive).

commonFailures.text: One missed deflect in a jump sequence voids 1-2.
A single Poison Wave going off voids 1-3.
A redirected slam clipping a teammate voids 1-3: keep the five spread spots.
Letting him escape the centre in Chase Phase: he's immune and keeps thrashing, and the 60-second clock for 2-3 runs out.
Too few players deflecting in the ball holder's red circle, so the ball drops and the Disappointment Meter fills.
Using Tai Chi too early on the water sword (wait until the circle is nearly full).

rewards: Inner Way Custom Note x3 (+3 first clear)
Chance: Melodic Stone / Attune Stone: Mirage, Dragonshadow Bow recipes

encounters.name: Segmented Puppets

bring: AoE / grouping Mystic Arts (Flute of the Tides-style pulls) for burst
notes: Neither boss dies to raw damage: both are pure mechanics checks (guild notes).
Clearing is free; claiming the reward costs 60 Energy.
Several talents need four or five players holding arms at once, so you can't solo them.
Destroying Centipede Remains and stopping Repeated Crushing use the interact button while holding an arm (F on PC).
Start deflecting from the pull; don't wait on cooldowns. One arm per person, no hoarding.

duties.ironheart-centipede: Pick up a dropped arm and destroy Centipede Remains at the edges before they reach the centre.
duties.ci-and-cuo: Handle mask markers on the far side.

duties.ironheart-centipede: Pick up an arm and stand in the Repeated Crushing lane; interrupt the first hit.
duties.ci-and-cuo: Handle mask markers near the centre and the secondary stages.

duties.ironheart-centipede: Deflect and DPS; take over a dropped arm if someone dies.
duties.ci-and-cuo: Call mask colours and watch for same-colour collisions.

bosses.name: Ironheart Centipede
bosses.summary: Deflect to drain the parry gauge (bar right of its HP). Empty gauge = Disarm: it drops exactly four bladed arms. Arms are used up when used, and the next two mechanics need two each.

mechanics.name: Crushing Roll
mechanics.trigger: Red-line AoE opener.
mechanics.response: Deflect it: the most reliable gauge drain.

mechanics.name: Hunting
mechanics.trigger: It marks one player and throws ten fast slashes.
mechanics.response: Whole team faces it and deflects through the string.

mechanics.name: Gold attacks / poison pools
mechanics.trigger: Gold indicators, including round poison pools.
mechanics.response: Dodge only: gold attacks can't be deflected.

mechanics.name: Disarm (Disarm Paralysis)
mechanics.trigger: Parry gauge hits zero.
mechanics.response: Four players each grab one arm, split two for Remains and two for Crushing as agreed. Disarm also stops Toxic Infusion stacking.

mechanics.name: Venom Leak
mechanics.trigger: After disarm: arena damage, stacking poison, and Centipede Remains crawling from the edges.
mechanics.response: Pair A uses the interact button with an arm to destroy Remains before they reach the centre and get absorbed.

mechanics.name: Repeated Crushing
mechanics.trigger: Gold shield; it rolls down a rectangular lane.
mechanics.response: Pair B stands in the lane and uses the interact button to stop it. Interrupt the first attack every time; two interrupts each take half the shield.
mechanics.note: Stand in the lane before it starts; sprinting in late is how this fails.

mechanics.name: Toxic Infusion
mechanics.trigger: Builds while you're slow to empty the gauge.
mechanics.response: Stacks power up Predation and Bite; at 3 stacks Bite is lethal. Treat 2 stacks in the armed state as the emergency and deflect fast.

talents.condition: Destroy Centipede Remains with a dropped arm at least once.
Interrupt Repeated Crushing at least once (with a dropped arm).
Interrupt the first attack of every Repeated Crushing, and no Remains get absorbed.
Make more than 15 deflects during the first regular (armed) phase.
talents.notes: Game8 and the in-game text both say the first regular phase.

talents.condition: Deflect 10 times during Hunting without being hit.
Trigger Disarm within 60 seconds, with fewer than 3 Toxic Infusions and fewer than 2 Venom Leaks.
talents.notes: Where Guilds Meet counts the limits per phase change.

bosses.worldBossNote: The trial Centipede shares a model with the Hidden Mountain world boss (added 2.0) but fights completely differently, so ignore world-boss habits.

bosses.name: Ci and Cuo
bosses.summary: Six dancer puppets (red and blue) are scattered around, with raised secondary stages at the edges. Break up to two puppets early, before the boss makes them immune.

mechanics.name: Dance, My Friend
mechanics.trigger: Gold circles on targeted players; each gets a red or blue mask.
mechanics.response: Run to a puppet of the opposite colour, start its charge, and lead it into its opposite-colour partner so they merge into a pair.
mechanics.note: Pairs keep the boss from powering up. Get every puppet where it's going within 10 seconds.

mechanics.name: No partner left
mechanics.trigger: Your marked colour has no opposite puppet to merge with.
mechanics.response: Drag the charging puppet onto an empty secondary stage to park it.

mechanics.name: Same-colour collision
mechanics.trigger: Two same-coloured puppets touch.
mechanics.response: Never let it happen: watch your path, since charging puppets hit anything in front of them.

mechanics.name: Hand in Hand
mechanics.trigger: A paired puppet aims a straight charge lane at a player.
mechanics.response: Point the lane at another pair to knock both down.
mechanics.note: Do knockdowns early: you need four pairs alive when the boss dies.

mechanics.name: Thousandfold Swords
mechanics.trigger: Rotating gold lines from the boss or partner.
mechanics.response: No deflect. Walk out of every line.

mechanics.name: Dance between Flowers
mechanics.trigger: Boss cast with a red circle.
mechanics.response: Players inside the red circle deflect to interrupt. If it's missed, an arena-wide follow-up fires; the outer ring is safe, and survivors get a chain-blade debuff.

talents.condition: Use one paired puppet's charge to knock down two other pairs at once.
Take no damage from Thousandfold Swords.
Kill the boss with more than four puppet pairs still on the field.
talents.verifyNote: In-game text says 'more than four'; Game8 and allthings.how say 'at least four'.

talents.condition: Guide a puppet onto a secondary stage at least once.
Never let two same-coloured puppets connect.
Every player finishes guiding puppets in under 10 seconds, and each player is hit by puppets fewer than 5 times.
talents.verifyNote: In-game text says 'less than 5'; Game8 says 'no more than 5'.

bosses.worldBossNote: Ci & Cuo is also a Hidden Mountain world boss (2.0). The trial fight is different.

commonFailures.text: A Remain reached the centre and was absorbed (voids 1-3).
Only one player stood in the Repeated Crushing lane.
Someone took a hit during Hunting (breaks 2-2).
Disarm took over a minute, adding Toxic and Venom Leak casts (breaks 2-3).
Two same-coloured puppets touched: 2-2 is gone for the run.
Boss died without enough pairs up (the game says more than four), usually from spending pairs on knockdowns (1-1) too late.

commonFailures: Talents only show on the results screen at the end of the run, not mid-fight.

encounters.name: Serpent's Fang

bring: Flute of the Tides (gathers Snake Doctor's four fire snakes, lures the ice snake)
Optional tank (Thundercry Blade / Stormbreaker Spear) for Blood Mist
notes: Weekly cap: 5 Fang Chests + 5 Serpent Chests, no Energy cost. Resets Monday 05:00 UTC+8.
Mostly a carry run now.

duties.wolf-maiden: DPS; deflect for Severing Howl targets.
duties.snake-doctor: Take fire snake #1 together and stay together in its poison circle.

duties.wolf-maiden: DPS; deflect for Severing Howl targets.

duties.snake-doctor: Keep both snake pairs topped up.

mechanics.name: Blood Mist
mechanics.trigger: Mist drops under targeted players.
mechanics.response: Walk it to the arena edge so the centre stays clear.

mechanics.name: Flying Rain / Chasing Moon waves
mechanics.trigger: Projectile waves start.
mechanics.response: Best: time Soaring Spin at about 95% of the cast bar, which skips the slow and the wolf transformation. Safe fallback: step into the mist, turn into a wolf (auto-run, steer only) and use the speed to dodge.
mechanics.verifyNote: Turning into a wolf this way may fail talent 1-3 (Where Guilds Meet).
mechanics.note: Game8: in wolf form, touching Blood Orbs heals the team.

mechanics.name: Wolf adds
mechanics.trigger: Adds spawn.
mechanics.response: Kill them right away.

mechanics.name: Summoned wolf
mechanics.trigger: A wolf charges a random player and applies vulnerability.
mechanics.response: Swap to it and kill it quickly.

mechanics.name: Severing Howl
mechanics.trigger: Gold circle on one player, then a knockdown and a red follow-up.
mechanics.response: Marked player leaves the group. Teammates step into the red circle and deflect, or the marked player dies.

mechanics.name: Blood Moon
mechanics.trigger: Blood Moons appear.
mechanics.response: Touch one (talents 2-1 / 2-3) but no more than one.

talents.condition: Help teammates deflect at least twice during Moon Cleave and Severing Howl.
Nobody dies while transformed into a wolf.
Nobody turns into a wolf from Blood Mist except through Moon Cleave and Severing Howl.
Touch at least one Blood Moon during Chasing Moon.
HP never drops below 50% during Chasing Moon.
During Chasing Moon, touch at most one Blood Moon, and nobody dies.

mechanics.name: Triple Poison (Venom Burst)
mechanics.trigger: Gold circles on three players.
mechanics.response: Spread out at once: overlapping explosions kill.

mechanics.name: Serpent Claw
mechanics.trigger: Rectangular waves that also aim at gold circles.
mechanics.response: Keep moving, stay out of red zones, and wait for the damage window after.

mechanics.name: Thousand Snakes
mechanics.trigger: Rectangle zones are marked first.
mechanics.response: Step out of each zone; save burst for after.

mechanics.name: Two large fire snakes
mechanics.trigger: Two big fire snakes spawn, each with a poison circle.
mechanics.response: Split into pairs, one pair per snake, healers in the middle. One person alone in a circle stacks poison and dies. Bring both down evenly and kill them within a few seconds of each other (a talent condition).

mechanics.name: Four venomous fire snakes
mechanics.trigger: Four smaller fire snakes appear.
mechanics.response: Pull them together with Flute of the Tides and melee them. They leave poison pools when they die: stack the pools into one big pool.

mechanics.name: Large ice snake
mechanics.trigger: A big ice snake appears.
mechanics.response: Lure it into the big poison pool with Flute of the Tides. It shrinks and weakens, so burst it.

talents.condition: Take no damage from Fierce Snake or Snake Hand.
Don't die during Thousand Snakes, and move no more than 30 m while it lasts.
Nobody dies to the Cold (ice) Snake, and it's shrunk within 10 seconds of spawning.
Never step on fire poison.
Nobody dies to the Flame Snakes, and Snake Venom Burn never goes above 1 stack.
Nobody dies to the Flame Snakes, and both are killed within 5 seconds of each other.

commonFailures.text: Using the Blood Mist wolf route for Flying Rain can count as an extra transformation and break 1-3; use Soaring Spin instead.
Running into teammates as a wolf gives them a vulnerability debuff.
A fire-snake circle handled by one player instead of a pair.
Large fire snakes killed far apart instead of together.

encounters.name: Landscourge Thunder

notes: Decide who calls rock colours (green → yellow → red) before the pull.
Mostly a carry run now.

duties.earth-fiend-deity: Call rock states and whether the next attack should hit or miss a rock.

duties.wandering-ark: Split in two for the left and right pillars, then regroup on the legs (left legs first).

bosses.name: Wandering Ark

bosses.worldBossNote: The Wandering Ark is also a Hexi world boss (from Version 1.4). The raid version is a different fight.

mechanics.name: Desert Stone Pillars
mechanics.trigger: Eight pillars spawn at the start; each gives the boss damage reduction.
mechanics.response: Split left/right and clear them with AoE, then regroup on the legs.

mechanics.name: Burning leg (Burning Roots)
mechanics.trigger: Red circle, then the most-damaged leg catches fire.
mechanics.response: Move off it and hit another leg until the flames die.
mechanics.note: The in-game callouts name a specific foot to hit 'to feed the flames'. Check in game which leg to focus.

mechanics.name: Desert Guardian + Buckthorn Bloom
mechanics.trigger: A shielded Guardian spawns at the edge doing raid damage; two players get arrows and thorn vines grow behind them.
mechanics.response: One marked player lights their vines at a burning leg, the other stands at the Guardian. Connect the trails so fire reaches it and breaks the shield; kill it and go back. Missed? Wait for the repeat.
mechanics.note: The game calls it the Desert Demon Guard. Talent 1-2 is about the inner circle of its slam.

mechanics.name: Moon Fragments (phase 2)
mechanics.trigger: Ark becomes an ally; the shielded giant Titan appears with three guarded Moon Fragments.
mechanics.response: Small teams grab all three to charge the Ark, which breaks Titan's shield and shrinks it. Burn it, repeat when the shield returns.
mechanics.note: The game calls them moon shadows.

mechanics.name: Burning Crow (Utuk Raptor)
mechanics.trigger: A bird breathes fire on the Ark.
mechanics.response: Cloud Steps to the tower roof and fire the ballista. The fragment runner nearest the tower usually takes it.
mechanics.note: In-game names: Fiend Flame, and a rooftop crossbow rather than a ballista.

mechanics.name: Sand Howl (Sandstorm)
mechanics.trigger: Titan starts a sandstorm cast.
mechanics.response: Get to high ground right away: the ballista platform or the Ark's deck. Don't hide inside the tower, where Sand Poison stacks (more damage taken).

mechanics.name: Mirage Waves
mechanics.trigger: Waves roll across the ground.
mechanics.response: Jump to stay off the ground (in-game callout).

mechanics.name: Demon From Above
mechanics.trigger: Adds land on the Ark's deck.
mechanics.response: Kill them to protect the Ark (in-game callout).

talents.condition: Take no damage from a burning leg.

talents.condition: Never go above 40 stacks of Sand Poison.

bosses.summary: Qing Qingqing on the ground is the kill target. Zhuge Ha sits on a big cloud above and must be handled or his finale wipes you.
bosses.worldBossNote: Pocketrupt Circus is also a world boss (Cleardew Terrace, Liangzhou). Different fight.

mechanics.name: Lucky Audience
mechanics.trigger: A player turns into a circus ball with a timer.
mechanics.response: Swap to the ball and break it before it explodes. Later three balls can appear: only the first (with the on-screen marker) is real.

mechanics.name: Fire Rings
mechanics.trigger: Rows of fire rings move toward the centre.
mechanics.response: Jump cleanly through the centre for a short damage buff. You don't need it to clear, but talents 1-1 and 1-3 do need it. Touching flame hurts a lot.
mechanics.note: The game calls this 'Fire Ring Jump'.

mechanics.name: Needles Upon Landing
mechanics.trigger: Gold circles on three players; spikes erupt and later turn into Smoke Clouds.
mechanics.response: Sources differ: Game8 says drop the spikes fairly close together (not stacked, not at opposite ends); the in-game callout just says spread out. Either way, don't stack them.
mechanics.verifyNote: Game8 and the in-game callout disagree on spacing.

mechanics.name: Bounce, Bounce, Bounce
mechanics.trigger: Qing Qingqing shields and leaps at one player repeatedly.
mechanics.response: Target leads her onto Smoke Spikes. Each landing takes a big chunk of shield (and turns the spike into a cloud). Burn her when it breaks.

mechanics.name: Zhuge Ha: Smoke Shroud / Big Finale
mechanics.trigger: Stacks build on the raid while his performance meter fills; the finale scales with stacks.
mechanics.response: Five players hop the small clouds (each lasts 5 steps) up to his big cloud and kill him to interrupt the show.
mechanics.note: Game names: Shrouding Smoke (up to 7 stacks, 40 s each) and Grand Trick (the finale). Fewer stacks = less finale damage (talent 1-2: 4 or fewer).

mechanics.name: Winds Arise
mechanics.trigger: A tornado forms in the middle and swallows remaining small clouds, each one powering its final hit.
mechanics.response: Once the cloud team is up, ground players step on unused clouds until they vanish. Clear as many as possible first.
mechanics.note: The game calls it 'Wind, Arise!' (Smoke Whirlwind). Talent 2-3: it may absorb 3 clouds at most.

talents.condition: Gain the fire-ring buff 2 times.
Gain no more than 4 stacks of Shrouding Smoke.
The whole team takes fewer than 10 fire-ring hits in total and gains the fire-ring buff 20 times.
Stomp 2 smoke clouds (only the last player to stomp a cloud gets credit).
Interrupt Qing Qingqing's Bounce, Bounce, Bounce with a smoke spike.
The Smoke Whirlwind absorbs no more than 3 smoke clouds.

Fragment teams too slow, so the Ark dies (wipe).
Hitting a fake ball instead of the first one.
Spending small clouds carelessly, so the team can't reach Zhuge Ha.
Leftover clouds when the tornado hits: very likely wipe.
Skipping the fire rings means 1-1 and 1-3 never register.
Taking more than 4 Shrouding Smoke stacks (breaks 1-2).
